request.style: English, slow Delta blues, gravelly weathered male vocal, resonator slide guitar, harmonica, upright bass, brushed kick and snare, earnest and searching, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
With what shall I come before the LORD, and bow down before God on high
With what shall I come before the LORD, and bow down before God on high
Shall I burn him a year-old calf and send the smoke up to the sky

[Verse]
Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil
Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil
Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul

[Chorus]
He has told you, O man, what is good
And what the LORD requires of you
Only to do justice
To love mercy
And to walk humbly with your God

[Verse]
I have seen the altar smoking while the widow's door was shut
Seen a hand raised up in worship while the other filled its cup
He is not after cattle and he is not after show
He wants an honest heart and a humble road to go

[Chorus]
He has told you, O man, what is good
And what the LORD requires of you
Only to do justice
To love mercy
And to walk humbly with your God

[Outro]
To do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God
